title: Workbook Table Editor
description: A plain-table spreadsheet grid over the hand-rolled headless workbook core (WORKBOOK-1-BUILD-SPEC.md WB-1): CSV import/export, formula bar, keyboard navigation, range selection, and a digest-selected-range-to-manifest action for verifiable-compute pipelines. Not an Excel replacement, CSV only.

csv.description: RFC 4180 CSV text to import (pasted or file-loaded, never fetched)

manifest.description: range, values_digest (sha256 via the shared _hash.mjs canonicalizer), produced_at

mcp_tool_definition.name: edit_workbook_table
mcp_tool_definition.description: Loads CSV into a cell grid, recalculates formulas (SUM/AVG/MIN/MAX/COUNT/COUNTIF/IF/AND/OR/NOT/ROUND/ABS/CONCAT/LEN/LEFT/RIGHT/TRIM/UPPER/LOWER/SUMIF), and digests a selected range into a manifest fragment for downstream verifiable-compute pipelines.
